A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MISA study, including appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment; 44 of 47 pages are visually identical. The overflowing notation in v1 is recoverable from its PDF text.

before.justification: Section 5 reports original MISA fine-tuning and C4 pre-training results, including accuracy, perplexity and memory measurements. Appendices B and C contain additional experiments and ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains the original MISA experimental results in Section 5 and the additional experiments and ablations in Appendices B and C.

M1.justification: The module partitioning, gradient-based importance sampling, Adam updates and optimizer-state clearing are unchanged. Algorithms 1–2 and the LoRA+MISA procedure in Appendix B.2 are retained.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same commonsense and arithmetic reasoning datasets, Alpaca-GPT4 instruction tuning, MMLU/MMLU-pro/MT-Bench evaluations and C4 pre-training. Appendix experiments introduce no coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including LoRA, DoRA, LISA and BAdam in reasoning comparisons, Adam and GaLore in pre-training, and LoRA+IST in Appendix B.2.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix H retain identical training and evaluation settings, including three-epoch fine-tuning, five-shot MMLU/MMLU-pro evaluation and 52,000-step pre-training. No protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Appendix C retains the same optimizer-state, hyperparameter, inner-loop length, sampling-strategy, importance-score and module ablations. Appendix B's memory-scaling and computational-efficiency analyses are also unchanged.

E5.justification: The same point estimates and learning curves are reported. No repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings match throughout. For example, Table 6 retains LLaMA 350M perplexities of 21.30 for Adam, 24.34 for GaLore at rank 256, and 22.11 for MISA at a 25% sampling threshold.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, propositions, convergence proofs and memory/computation derivations are unchanged. Appendix D.1 reformats the existing full-parameter and filtration definitions without altering their mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about module-wise importance sampling, memory efficiency, empirical effectiveness and O(1/sqrt(K)) convergence.

C2.justification: Interpretations of MISA as regularization and explanations of sampling behavior are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning large-scale pre-training, multimodal models and non-Transformer architectures.

D1.justification: The source-code access statement and link, hardware description, algorithm details and Appendix H hyperparameters are unchanged. The funding rewrite adds no technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains the same research positioning, and the bibliography cites the same works. The reference text on page 12 is merely repositioned following the expanded acknowledgements.

P1.justification: Section 7 replaces a general NSFC funding statement with separate acknowledgements for Kun Yuan and Tao Yao, adding grant numbers. Title-page dates and version text are updated; scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Appendix D.1 places two definitions on separate lines, bringing the full-parameter formula, previously clipped at the right page edge, fully into view. Expanded acknowledgements shift references on page 12. Figures and tables are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 fixes a concrete readability defect: the full-parameter definition in Appendix D.1 is now fully visible. Funding attribution is also more specific. These provide a limited presentation improvement while the scientific methods, evidence, claims and limitations remain unchanged.
